Anurag Kumar Appointed New Delhi Police Commissioner

Anurag Kumar, formerly a Special Director with the Intelligence Bureau, has taken charge as the new Commissioner of Delhi Police. He replaces Satish Golcha in the position. The appointment marks a transition in leadership for the city's police force.
